about: Hand-written responses with known problems, for checking the checks. Each run's `expect` lists the rule@location findings that should flag; anything else that flags is a false positive. Run: npm run copy-check -- scripts/copy-check-canaries.json

response.note: Nice and small today. We'll start with the easy wins and see how it feels.

missions.title: Mugs to the Sink
missions.description: Carry the two mugs on the desk and the plate by the bed to the kitchen sink.
missions.strategy: Stack the plate on top and hold both mugs in one hand so it's a single trip.

missions.title: Floor Clothes Roundup
missions.description: Every shirt and sock on the floor between the bed and the wardrobe goes into the basket.
missions.strategy: Start at the doorway and work toward the window. Don't sort, just scoop.

response.note: Your roommate on the sofa has clearly given up. You don't have to.

missions.title: Hoodie Situation
missions.description: Get the guy on the bed to hand over that grey hoodie he's wearing, then basket every other shirt on the floor.
missions.strategy: Start with the pile nearest the door and scoop with both arms.

response.note: This room is about to get a glow-up and you're the star.

missions.title: Wrapper Wipeout (alt: Snack Attack)
missions.description: Bag every wrapper and can on the coffee table and floor.
missions.strategy: Open the bag first and keep it in your left hand.

missions.title: Desk Reset
missions.description: Gather the [ITEM] on the desk into one box. [Note: keep this under 25 words]
missions.strategy: Pick the box first, then sweep everything toward it.

response.note: Honestly, only a lazy person with zero self-respect lives like this.

missions.title: Garbage Human Cleanup
missions.description: Bag the takeaway boxes on the desk. Your ADHD brain probably forgot they exist.
missions.strategy: Start with the box nearest the chair and work left.

response.note: Okay queen, let's make this bedroom slay, sweetie!

missions.title: Laundry Slay, Babe
missions.description: Toss every sock and shirt on the floor into the basket, hun.
missions.strategy: Start by the bed and work toward the door in one sweep.

response.note: A few small things and this room will feel lighter.

missions.title: Books Back Home
missions.description: Put the four books on the floor by the bed back on the shelf above the desk.
missions.strategy: You've totally got this. Every little bit counts, so be proud of yourself!

response.note: Take every plate on the nightstand to the sink. Now.

missions.title: Plates. Sink. Now.
missions.description: Carry the three plates on the nightstand to the kitchen sink.
missions.strategy: Stack them first so it's one trip.

response.note: A few things drifted off their spots. Quick resets only.

missions.title: Floor Clothes To Hamper
missions.description: The shirts and jeans on the floor by the bed go into the hamper.
missions.strategy: Start at the foot of the bed and scoop toward the hamper.

missions.title: Jacket Back On Its Hook
missions.description: Take the blue jacket off the desk chair and hang it on its hook by the door.
missions.strategy: Grab it on your way out of the room so it's one trip.

response.note: The sofa has quietly turned into a laundry pile. We'll take it one armful at a time, no sorting.

missions.title: Clear The Sofa Seat
missions.description: The clothes piled on the sofa cushions go into the laundry basket.
missions.strategy: Start at the left armrest and work right. Scoop by the armful, no folding or sorting.

response.note: Ladies and gentlemen, the sofa. Once seating, now a walk-in wardrobe with cushions. Let's give it its job back.

missions.title: Sofa Evicts Wardrobe
missions.description: Take the clothes piled on the right half of the sofa to the laundry basket.
missions.strategy: Scoop it all in one armful. No sorting clean from dirty; that's a future problem.

response.note: Let's clear a little space together.

missions.title: Mug Rescue
missions.description: Carry the three mugs and the cereal bowl on the desk to the kitchen sink.
missions.strategy: Nest the mugs inside the bowl so it's one trip.
